title: Official historical HS300 membership source feasibility
classification: pre-registered source discovery; no alpha search and no return backtest
question: Can official CSI index-provider records reconstruct date-effective HS300 membership across the available research window, including routine and exceptional constituent changes, with auditable publication/effective dates?

hypotheses.H1: The CSI index provider publishes official historical routine adjustment notices or historical sample files that can be retrieved and verified.
hypotheses.H2: A complete reconstruction also requires coverage of exceptional membership changes between routine semiannual reviews.
hypotheses.H3: If official records do not cover the required events and effective dates, a defensible point-in-time HS300 universe cannot be reconstructed from this source alone.

scope.primary_source: China Securities Index Co. (CSI), official index provider
scope.secondary_source_use: Search engines may locate official CSI documents only; non-official membership histories cannot establish the primary-source claim.
required_fields: added/removed status or complete dated sample

method: Freeze and register this source-discovery question before external queries.
Search CSI's official web domain for routine semiannual adjustment notices and historical constituent files in the fixed window.
Inspect accessible official source documents and record exact dates, downloadable payload hashes, and coverage gaps.
Check whether the official history includes temporary/exceptional changes or whether a complete daily reconstruction would still be ambiguous.

execution_addendum.classification: prospective amendment after panel registration but before the fixed official API query; exploratory endpoint discovery occurred before this amendment
execution_addendum.deviation: Initial unarchived reconnaissance fetched the official CSI JavaScript bundle and homepage, inspected endpoint strings, and made search-engine requests whose raw responses were not retained. Those probes are exploratory and are excluded from the evidence basis. A scratch homepage response was written to an untracked temp file and will be preserved as a hashed exploratory artifact rather than deleted.
execution_addendum.fixed_query: Use the official CSI frontend-discovered endpoint /csindex-home/announcement/queryAnnouncementByVo. Send one primary request with page={page:1,rows:100,desc:""} and one control request matching the homepage UI default page={page:1,rows:5,desc:""}; both use lang=cn and empty classlist/indexlist/related_topics/typelist. Retain the full official JSON responses and hashes. Search only within those retained responses for HS300/000300 sample-change records.
execution_addendum.limits: If the endpoint returns only recent records, reports, or incomplete archive pages, classify the coverage as insufficient; do not infer a complete historical event series from absence of search results.

decision_rule.feasible: Only if the official source provides complete coverage of every effective membership event in the target window, with unambiguous effective dates and a verifiable seed membership.
decision_rule.no_go: If any period or exceptional event lacks official, date-effective evidence, do not reconstruct missing membership from current constituents or non-official guesses.
decision_rule.next_step_if_feasible: Create a separately frozen research-only membership artifact outside the production current-members service; independently validate transitions and use it only in a pre-registered system backtest.

prohibited_in_this_round: No mining job, factor return calculation, strategy backtest, or candidate promotion/publication.
No use of current membership as a historical proxy.
No production membership changes, provider sync, data rebuild, or strategy/cache mutation.
No silent filling of missing adjustment events from third-party websites.

panel_registration.candidate_name: R304 中证官方历史成分数据源可行性（无收益回测）

success_criteria: Query plan, scope and feasibility rule are frozen before any external search.
All panel registration request/response and post-registration GET evidence are retained.
Official source documents are retained verbatim or with stable official URLs and SHA-256 hashes.
Conclusion explicitly says whether complete point-in-time reconstruction is feasible and why.
